maria_infra: Quick heads-up — saw a p95 latency regression (~18%) on mixtral-8x after yesterday's AWQ rollout to dedicated. Suspect RoPE scaling mismatch + KV eviction thrash causing kernel fallback.

gabe_runtime: ugh, saw that in the smoke tests too. traces show more attention slow-paths and a bunch of `fallback_int8_gemm` hits.

liam_ml: can you paste a trace snippet? also which prompt calibration did we use for AWQ? different prompts can shift quantization boundaries for heads/kv.

maria_infra: trace + perf snapshot attached below (pasted). calibration used: `chatty_beam_1000` set — maybe too chatty for mixtral head sparsity.

perf-bot: Profiling summary (2026-03-18 09:12 UTC)
```
Model: mixtral-8x-gguf-awq
HW: p4d.24xlarge (A100)
Scenario: steady 80rps, batch target 4
p50: 22ms, p95: 132ms (baseline p95 112ms)
KV hit rate: 72% -> dropped to 55% under this workload
Kernel fallback count: fused_attn_fast: 418k -> 312k, fallback_int8_gemm: 54k -> 199k
Most-calls: attention_long_seq (90% of time)
```

gabe_runtime: KV hit rate drop + fallback_int8_gemm spikes = two things: RoPE mismatch causing more cache churn (different prefix overlaps -> different KV keys) AND AWQ kernels not selected for some sequence lengths so runtime falls back.

sasha_opt: noticed similar behaviour with head-dim mismatch on long-context evals. when RoPE scaling is off by factor 2 for token positions > 2048, the cache entries look different and we evict more. Also AWQ's per-tensor scales on QKV can push kernels past our vector-width alignment and fall back.

liam_ml: hypothesis: calibration prompts biased to short-turn dialogues produced quant scales that degrade on long prefix patterns; leads to numeric noise in KV that prevents exact cache hits. small noise -> cache key mismatch in our deterministic keying.

maria_infra: here's a reproduce recipe I ran locally:
```
# reproduce harness (trimmed)
python perf_harness/run.py --model mixtral-8x-awq --prompt-set long-prefix-4000.json --rps 80 --batch-target 4 --seed 42
# collect traces: /tmp/traces/mixtral_awq_1987654321
```

gabe_runtime: thanks. I ran with `--batch-target 8` and saw throughput increase but p95 still bad due to long-tail kernel fallbacks. Could be kernel selector threshold too aggressive for INT8 FP32 mix.

liam_ml: propose we try two experiments:
- 1) Recalibrate AWQ using a mix of short/long prompts (add a few long-prefix examples + rare tokens)
- 2) Temporarily force kernel policy to prefer `int8_gemm_aligned` for seq_len >= 1024 to avoid fallback (if available)

sasha_opt: + Also tune KV prefetch window and cache-key tolerance: we can relax exact-match keying to allow small float noise, e.g., quantize KV key to 8-bit fingerprint so tiny perturbations still hit. That should reduce evictions.

perf-bot: Quick config diff snippet suggested by runtime:
```
{"kernel_policy": {
  "prefer_aligned_int8": true,
  "seq_len_threshold": 1024
},
"kv_cache": {
  "fingerprint_mode": "8bit", 
  "prefetch_window_tokens": 64
}}
```

gabe_runtime: I can spin a canary with those kernel flags + kv fingerprinting on dedicated pool. Will run the same harness.

maria_infra: can we also try AWQ recal with `calibration_mix_v2`? liam, can you prepare the prompt set?

liam_ml: will do. plan: 1k short/dialogue, 1k long/prefix, 200 rare-token heavy. Use same AWQ pipeline but set `per_channel=true` for QKV and add clip threshold 2.5.

sasha_opt: note: per_channel may increase memory, but for mixtral heads it's worth it — reduces quant noise on heads by ~0.4 L2 in our sims.

maria_infra: timeline: canary today on pool `dedicated-canary-7`, gather 1h of steady traffic, compare p95 and KV hit rate. If p95 < +5% and KV hit >70% we rollback AWQ rollout to this version.

gabe_runtime: started canary at 09:30 UTC. I left traces and the quick dashboard at https://internal.redwood/prof/mixtral-canary-1987654321

perf-bot: Canary snapshot (10m): p50 23ms p95 118ms KV hit 71% fallback_int8_gemm 23k

maria_infra: promising. keep running for 1h. liam please upload calibration set & config to the shared bucket so we can reproduce later.

liam_ml: uploaded to s3://rw-eval/mixtral/awq_recal_mixv2/1987654321/ with sha256: b94f6c3a. Also included eval script and quality checks (perp + q-score).

sasha_opt: follow-ups: (1) add kernel selector metrics to perf dashboard, (2) add kv fingerprinting gauge, (3) add AWQ calibration tests into CI emulating long-prefix patterns.

maria_infra: agree. owners: gabe -> canary & kernel flags; liam -> recal & eval; sasha -> kv fingerprint + dashboard. I'll coordinate rollback policy if canary degrades.

gabe_runtime: noted, will post a short postmortem if anything odd.

liam_ml: will run quality checks after recal and report accuracy delta. aim is <0.5% delta on our eval set.

maria_infra: perfect. thanks all :thumbsup:
